nameEn: Manufacture of irradiation, electromedical and electrotherapeutic equipment
description: This class includes the manufacture of irradiation, electromedical and electrotherapeutic apparatus and equipment.
includes: manufacture of X-ray apparatus and tubes
manufacture of medical, surgical, dental or veterinary X-ray equipment
manufacture of MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) apparatus
manufacture of radiation therapy equipment: particle accelerators, linear accelerators
manufacture of electromedical apparatus: pacemakers, hearing aids, defibrillators
manufacture of electrotherapeutic apparatus: diathermy, short-wave therapy, ultrasound therapy
manufacture of equipment for nuclear medicine imaging: PET scanners, gamma cameras
manufacture of other irradiation apparatus: for industrial or scientific use
excludes: manufacture of measuring and testing instruments, see 2651
manufacture of spectacles and lenses, see 3250
manufacture of dental instruments and supplies, see 3250
